changes.reason: Separate paged configuration history from complete published candidates and serialize publication capacity with existing PostgreSQL transaction/advisory-lock primitives. Reuses the existing Drizzle PostgreSQL provider, schema and index; no migration or platform claim is added. New publications require statement-fresh read-committed snapshots and reject repeatable-read and serializable transactions, including mixed-isolation callers, without changing caller isolation.

constraints: Requires the existing PostgreSQL migration, transactional execute boundary and advisory locks.
Local PostgreSQL results do not certify deployed hosts.
